## Purpose

This script identifies **candidate trophically transmitted ASVs**: Present in **adult insects and spiders**

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE} knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
rm(list = ls()) # Clean environment

library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)
```

## Load data

```{r load-data}
load("R_output/ps_objects/GrandRiverMB_phyloseq_filt_unnorm.RData")

# Define prevalence Thresholds
label_threshold <- 0.5           # For bold (vertically transmitted) SP:0.5, 
gray_label_threshold <- 0.7      # For gray (high prevalence in either stage)
# -----------------------------
# User-defined taxonomic rank
taxrank <- "Genus"   # e.g., "Species", "Genus", "Family"
# -----------------------------
```

```{r prep-phlyloseq-object}
ps <- tax_glom(ps_final, taxrank = taxrank)
otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps))
if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu <- t(otu)
otu <- as.data.frame(otu)
otu <- otu[, sapply(otu, is.numeric)]

meta <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
taxonomy_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps))

# Create readable Taxon Label
if (taxrank == "Species") {
  taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label <- paste(taxonomy_df$Genus, taxonomy_df$Species, sep = "_")
} else {
  taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label <- taxonomy_df[[taxrank]]
}

taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label <- gsub(" ", "_", taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label)
taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label <- gsub("__+", "_", taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label)
taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label <- gsub("_$", "", taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label)
taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label <- gsub("^_", "", taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label)

# Map OTUs to taxon names
name_map <- taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label
names(name_map) <- rownames(taxonomy_df)
colnames(otu) <- ifelse(colnames(otu) %in% names(name_map),
                        name_map[colnames(otu)],
                        colnames(otu))

# Prevalence filter (optional)
prevalence_threshold <- 0.0
prevalent_taxa <- colnames(otu)[colSums(otu > 0) >= prevalence_threshold * nrow(otu)]
otu_filtered <- otu[, prevalent_taxa]

# Align metadata and OTU table
shared_ids <- intersect(rownames(otu_filtered), rownames(meta))
otu_filtered <- otu_filtered[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
otu_filtered <- otu_filtered[order(rownames(otu_filtered)), ]
meta <- meta[order(rownames(meta)), ]
stopifnot(identical(rownames(otu_filtered), rownames(meta)))

```

## Setup Output and Variables

```{r}
group_var <- "Location"
taxa_list <- unique(meta$Taxa)

output_dir <- "R_output/plots_trophic_transmission"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label_clean <- gsub("_", " ", taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label)
taxa_name_lookup <- taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label_clean
names(taxa_name_lookup) <- rownames(taxonomy_df)

# Global abundance range for scaling
rel_abund_all <- otu_filtered / rowSums(otu_filtered)
mean_rel_abund_all <- colMeans(rel_abund_all, na.rm = TRUE)
global_min_abund <- min(mean_rel_abund_all[mean_rel_abund_all > 0])
global_max_abund <- max(mean_rel_abund_all)

caption_text <- paste0(
  "Bold labels: taxa present in ≥ ", label_threshold * 100, "% of both Adult and Spider samples\n",
  "Gray labels: taxa present in ≥ ", gray_label_threshold * 100, "% of either Adult or Spider samples"
)

```

## Identify trophic transmission

```{r id-trophic-transmission}
ps <- tax_glom(ps_final, taxrank = taxrank)
# Extract OTU table safely (samples as rows)
otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps))
if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}

# Ensure numeric matrix
otu <- as.data.frame(apply(otu, 2, as.numeric))
rownames(otu) <- sample_names(ps)
if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) { otu <- t(otu) }
otu <- otu[, sapply(otu, is.numeric)]
meta <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
taxonomy_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps))

# Create taxon label
if (taxrank == "Species") {
  taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label <- paste(taxonomy_df$Genus, taxonomy_df$Species, sep = "_")
} else {
  taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label <- taxonomy_df[[taxrank]]
}

# Clean taxon labels
taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label <- gsub(" ", "_", taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label)
taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label <- gsub("__+", "_", taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label)
taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label <- gsub("_$", "", taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label)
taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label <- gsub("^_", "", taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label)

# Replace OTU names
name_map <- taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label
names(name_map) <- rownames(taxonomy_df)
colnames(otu) <- ifelse(colnames(otu) %in% names(name_map),
                        name_map[colnames(otu)],
                        colnames(otu))

# Prevalence filter (optional)
prevalence_threshold <- 0.0
prevalent_taxa <- colnames(otu)[colSums(otu > 0) >= prevalence_threshold * nrow(otu)]
otu_filtered <- otu[, prevalent_taxa]

# Align metadata and OTU table
shared_ids <- intersect(rownames(otu_filtered), rownames(meta))
otu_filtered <- otu_filtered[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
otu_filtered <- otu_filtered[order(rownames(otu_filtered)), ]
meta <- meta[order(rownames(meta)), ]
stopifnot(identical(rownames(otu_filtered), rownames(meta)))

# ============================================================
# Set up plotting
# ============================================================

# Taxa list (invertebrate groups)
taxa_list <- unique(meta$Taxa)
group_var <- "Location"

output_trophic_dir <- "R_output/plots/Trophic_Transmission"
if (!dir.exists(output_trophic_dir)) dir.create(output_trophic_dir, recursive = TRUE)

caption_text <- paste0(
  "Bold labels: taxa present in ≥ ", label_threshold * 100, "% of both Adult and Spider samples\n",
  "Gray labels: taxa present in ≥ ", gray_label_threshold * 100, "% of either Adult or Spider samples"
)

taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label_clean <- gsub("_", " ", taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label)
taxa_name_lookup <- taxonomy_df$Taxon_Label_clean
names(taxa_name_lookup) <- rownames(taxonomy_df)

# Global abundance range for legends
rel_abund_all <- otu_filtered / rowSums(otu_filtered)
mean_rel_abund_all <- colMeans(rel_abund_all, na.rm = TRUE)
global_min_abund <- min(mean_rel_abund_all[mean_rel_abund_all > 0])
global_max_abund <- max(mean_rel_abund_all)

```

```{r}
for (taxon in taxa_list) {
  message("Processing Taxa: ", taxon)
  
  plots_by_location <- list()
  locations <- unique(meta[[group_var]])
  
  for (loc in locations) {
    message("  Location: ", loc)
    
    meta_sub <- meta %>%
      filter(Taxa == taxon, .data[[group_var]] == loc)
    
    # Skip if missing one of the two groups
    if (!all(c("Adult", "Spider") %in% meta_sub$Lifestage)) {
      message("    Skipping ", taxon, " (", loc, "): missing Adult or Spider samples.")
      next
    }
    
    otu_sub <- otu_filtered[rownames(meta_sub), , drop = FALSE]
    
    adult_idx <- which(meta_sub$Lifestage == "Adult")
    spider_idx <- which(meta_sub$Lifestage == "Spider")
    
    n_adult <- length(adult_idx)
    n_spider <- length(spider_idx)
    
    # Calculate prevalence
    prev_adult <- colSums(otu_sub[adult_idx, ] > 0) / n_adult
    prev_spider <- colSums(otu_sub[spider_idx, ] > 0) / n_spider
    
    # Mean relative abundance
    rel_abund <- otu_sub / rowSums(otu_sub)
    mean_rel_abund <- colMeans(rel_abund, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Data for plotting
    plot_df <- tibble(
      ASV = colnames(otu_sub),
      Prevalence_Adult = prev_adult,
      Prevalence_Spider = prev_spider,
      Mean_Relative_Abundance = mean_rel_abund
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        Taxon_Label = taxa_name_lookup[ASV],
        Taxon_Label = ifelse(is.na(Taxon_Label), ASV, Taxon_Label),
        Label_bold = ifelse(
          Prevalence_Adult >= label_threshold & Prevalence_Spider >= label_threshold,
          Taxon_Label, NA_character_),
        Label_gray = ifelse(
          (Prevalence_Adult >= gray_label_threshold | Prevalence_Spider >= gray_label_threshold) &
            !(Prevalence_Adult >= label_threshold & Prevalence_Spider >= label_threshold),
          Taxon_Label, NA_character_)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Mean_Relative_Abundance) & Mean_Relative_Abundance > 0)
    
    if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) next
    
    # Build plot
    p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Prevalence_Adult, y = Prevalence_Spider)) +
      geom_point(aes(size = Mean_Relative_Abundance, color = Mean_Relative_Abundance), alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_text_repel(aes(label = Label_bold), size = 4, fontface = "bold", color = "black",
                      max.overlaps = 20, force = 10, segment.size = 0.3) +
      geom_text_repel(aes(label = Label_gray), size = 3.5, color = "grey50",
                      max.overlaps = 20, force = 10, segment.size = 0.3) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
      scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
      scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", trans = "log10", na.value = "grey50",
                            limits = c(global_min_abund, global_max_abund), oob = scales::squish) +
      scale_size(range = c(1, 10), limits = c(global_min_abund, global_max_abund)) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(taxon, " — ", loc),
        x = "Prevalence in Adults",
        y = ifelse(loc == locations[1], "Prevalence in Spiders", NULL),
        caption = caption_text
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
      )
    
    plots_by_location[[loc]] <- p
  }
  
  if (length(plots_by_location) == 0) next
  
  # Combine plots side by side with shared y-axis label centered
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots_by_location, ncol = 2, guides = "collect") &
    plot_annotation(title = paste("Trophic Transmission —", taxon)) &
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", vjust = 1.5)
    )
  
  # Save output
  outfile <- file.path(output_trophic_dir, paste0("Trophic_Transmission_", taxon, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(outfile, combined_plot, width = 13, height = 6)
  message("Saved: ", outfile)
}
```
